bio: I study telecommunications and network engineering at the University of Doha for Science and Technology, and build products alongside it. It is one interest, not two: the firmware on a street-lighting rig and the retrieval layer behind a study companion are both systems where the interesting part is what happens between the components. I have taken a product from a 48-hour build to first place at the UHUB × Scale AI Sprint, and spoken at Web Summit Qatar.
currently: Finishing the degree at UDST, building Eshrahli, and open to freelance work.
